svg.title: Cost, drafts and reviewer points, with and without memory
svg.desc: Over 76 replayed pull requests, the CodeNib agent cost $11.08 against $21.52 (0.52 times), filed 102 drafts against 249 (0.41 times), and raised 36.5 reviewer points before the reviewer did, against 47 (0.78 times, 95% interval 0.60 to 0.97).
svg.text: 76 merged pull requests from astral-sh/ruff, pandas,
prometheus, vite and tokio, replayed with Claude Sonnet
5.5. Both agents wake for the same news and use the
same model, tools and instructions; the stateless one
rereads the whole context and keeps no memory.
